name: chroma1_hd_t2i
description: Chroma1-HD text-to-image (Comfy-Org template image_chroma_text_to_image): all core nodes, no hybrid loader. fp8mixed weights through UNETLoader, T5-XXL fp8 scaled (CLIPLoader type chroma) with T5TokenizerOptions 0/0, AuraFlow shift 1, BasicScheduler beta 26 steps, euler, CFGGuider 3.5. Shares the ae VAE with Z-Image. Apache-2.0.

negative.default: low quality, blurry, unfinished sketch, oversaturated, heavy bloom, chromatic aberration, artifacts, watermark

requires.pack: ComfyUI core 0.38 (CLIPLoader type chroma, comfy_extras/nodes_cond.py T5TokenizerOptions)
requires.assumed: graph copied from the official template; its long negative is shortened to our own wording
